text: Interactive Candlestick Charts: Visualize cryptocurrency price movements open, high, low, close data Real-Time Market Data: Access live cryptocurrency prices market statistics top 100 cryptocurrencies Historical Analysis: View historical price data dating back 2013 Advanced Filtering: Live search functionality quickly find cryptocurrency Multiple Timeframes: Flexible date range selectors (1 day -time) custom range slider Volume Analysis: Dedicated volume charts track trading activity Market Metrics: Comprehensive market data including market cap, dominance, 24h/7d/30d/60d/90d price changes Color-Coded Performance: Heat-map style coloring quick visual identification price movements
